{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Firestorm''''' was a plan created by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] to eradicate the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] presence on [[Ord Mynock/Legends|Ord Mynock]]. Imperial [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Tiber Quent]] used information from a cancelled project that could ignite a planet's atmosphere and was also known as Firestorm as bait so he could draw out Rebel agents.<ref name="Game">''[[Gamemaster Toolkit: Live-Action Adventures]]''</ref>
